MAT010.Archive.M010_A1_ordered_nine:
∀ {claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim} {snapshots : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot} {out : List MAT010.Archive.Artifact},
  MAT010.Archive.validate claims snapshots = some out →
    List.map MAT010.Archive.Claim.profile claims = MAT010.Archive.stages ∧
      List.map MAT010.Archive.Snapshot.identifier snapshots = MAT010.Archive.stages ∧
        claims.length = 9 ∧ snapshots.length = 9
MAT010.Archive.M010_A2_commit_identities:
∀ {claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim} {snapshots : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot} {out : List MAT010.Archive.Artifact},
  MAT010.Archive.validate claims snapshots = some out →
    (List.map MAT010.Archive.Claim.mergedCommit claims).Nodup ∧
      ∀ (claim : MAT010.Archive.Claim), claim ∈ claims → MAT010.Archive.validCommit claim.mergedCommit = true
MAT010.Archive.M010_A3_valid_artifact_id:
∀ {claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim} {snapshots : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot} {out : List MAT010.Archive.Artifact},
  MAT010.Archive.validate claims snapshots = some out →
    ∀ (artifact : MAT010.Archive.Artifact),
      artifact ∈ out →
        artifact.stage ∈ MAT010.Archive.stages ∧
          MAT010.Archive.validName artifact.name = true ∧
            MAT010.Archive.validDigest artifact.sha256 = true ∧
              (MAT010.Archive.hasMidiSuffix artifact.name = true → artifact.stage = MAT010.Archive.firstStage) ∧
                ∃ claim snapshot member,
                  (claim, snapshot) ∈ claims.zip snapshots ∧
                    member ∈ snapshot.members ∧
                      claim.version = artifact.version ∧ artifact = MAT010.Archive.artifactOf snapshot member
MAT010.Archive.M010_A4_unique_logical_pa:
∀ {claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim} {snapshots : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot} {out : List MAT010.Archive.Artifact},
  MAT010.Archive.validate claims snapshots = some out →
    (List.map MAT010.Archive.Artifact.logicalPath out).Nodup ∧
      Option.map MAT010.Archive.Artifact.stage out.getLast? = some MAT010.Archive.lastStage
MAT010.Archive.M010_A5_deterministic_enu:
∀ (claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim) {left right : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot},
  MAT010.Archive.SameMaps left right →
    (∀ (snapshot : MAT010.Archive.Snapshot),
        snapshot ∈ left → (List.map MAT010.Archive.Member.name snapshot.members).Nodup) →
      MAT010.Archive.emit claims left = MAT010.Archive.emit claims right ∧
        MAT010.Archive.validate claims left = MAT010.Archive.validate claims right
MAT010.Archive.M010_A6_fail_closed_malfo:
∀ (claims : List MAT010.Archive.Claim) (snapshots : List MAT010.Archive.Snapshot),
  MAT010.Archive.Malformed claims snapshots → MAT010.Archive.validate claims snapshots = none
MAT010.Archive.M010_A7_accepted_and_reje:
(MAT010.Archive.validate MAT010.Archive.demoClaims MAT010.Archive.demoSnapshots).isSome = true ∧
  (MAT010.Archive.validate MAT010.Archive.demoClaims MAT010.Archive.demoSnapshotsExtra).isSome = true ∧
    (MAT010.Archive.validate MAT010.Archive.demoClaims []).isNone = true
